description: This file defines the ConfigHandlerGroup class, which provides a form for configuring grouping and aggregation settings for a Views UI handler in Drupal. It includes methods for form construction, submission, and handling view and display configurations.

classes.name: ConfigHandlerGroup
classes.description: A Drupal form class for configuring grouping and aggregation in Views UI via AJAX.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the form with optional type and id.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Builds and returns the form for a specific view and display.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs the form array with grouping options and handles display validation.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, updates the view's handler, and caches the result.
